people.name: Chebar
people.line: River in Babylonia; location of Ezekiel's visions

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
translations.bsb: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the River Kebar, and I knew that they were cherubim.
translations.kjv: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
translations.asv: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
